adjudication.rationale: In `addGuests.handler.ts`, the blacklist is normalized to lowercase (`BLACKLISTED_GUEST_EMAILS.split(...).map(...toLowerCase())`), but the incoming `guest` strings are never lowercased before checks. The filters use exact string comparisons: duplicate guard `guest === attendee.email` and blacklist guard `!blacklistedGuestEmails.includes(guest)`. This makes both checks case-sensitive, so inputs like `Spam@Example.com` can bypass a blacklist entry `spam@example.com` and can also bypass duplicate detection against an existing attendee email with different casing, leading to unintended guest creation and emails.
